items.title: The most important thing I heard today:
items.author: Erik García Gundersen
items.body_excerpt:
The most important thing I heard today: 

Passing the bill only allows the city and the Blazers to actually negotiate a deal between the city’s legal negotiation team and the Blazers legal team. 

They have to put the ball in the NBA’s court. 

But the Blazers are def being very dodgy in public.
